meta.scope: Turkey Batch 7 — Lagging-region and equity densification: eastern/southeastern provincial contrast, low GDP-per-capita provinces, and regional disparity framing.

candidates.title: Eastern and southeastern lagging-regions framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from TurkStat provincial and poverty sources
candidates.description: System-level view of the eastern and southeastern provinces that form the lagging cluster in national regional accounts and poverty analysis. These regions account for a disproportionate share of remaining poverty relative to their GDP contribution.
candidates.notes: Key equity / lagging-region spatial node that contrasts with Istanbul–Ankara–Izmir and industrial Marmara provinces.

candidates.title: Van province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Van — among the provinces with the lowest GDP per capita in recent rankings. Illustrative eastern lagging-province node.

candidates.title: Şanlıurfa province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Şanlıurfa — a large southeastern province that ranks among the lowest in GDP per capita despite significant population and agricultural activity.

candidates.title: Regional disparity and convergence framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and development sources
candidates.description: Analytical and policy framing of inter-provincial and inter-regional disparities in GDP per capita, poverty and development outcomes. Continuously referenced in regional policy, investment incentives and equity discussions.
candidates.notes: System-level equity frame linking the dual spatial structure of the Turkish economy.

candidates.title: Turkey lagging-region densification meta-node
candidates.description: Meta-node binding eastern/southeastern lagging-regions framing, Van and Şanlıurfa GRDP series, and regional disparity/convergence framing into a coherent equity and lagging-region layer that complements the high-income provincial set.
